content.value: A company has secured a right to mine 100,000 tons of iron ore per (12)

year for 15 years. The current price per ton of iron ore is Tk. 3000 and it is expected to increase at the rate of 6% per year. What is the present value of the iron ore that you can mine if the discount rate is 16%?
